purpose: Canonical B03-A expected-occurrence descriptor for one self-scoped Event; it extends the existing Event NativeRef with the minimum durable expectation state without duplicating Event identity or storing temporal placement in the Event descriptor.

columns.name: event_ref
columns.meaning: Stable Event NativeRef whose minimum expected-occurrence descriptor this row carries.
columns.value_contract: References one existing UUIDv7 Event identity; the descriptor does not mint, replace or become that identity.

columns.name: self_person_ref
columns.meaning: Authenticated DANTE self Person whose personal Event context owns this descriptor.
columns.value_contract: Existing Person NativeRef resolved through DanteContext; Person remains distinct from Account, Principal and Actor.

columns.name: title
columns.meaning: Minimum user-authored expected-occurrence title for the Event.
columns.value_contract: Trimmed, non-empty, at most 300 characters; Schedule placement, recurrence, participation and outcome do not belong in this column.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: Canonical creation instant recorded by the bounded CreateEvent capability.
columns.value_contract: Statement-time instant supplied inside the authoritative PostgreSQL create capability.

primary_key.name: pk_event_expectation
primary_key.reason: Exactly one minimum B03-A expectation descriptor is materialized per Event identity.

foreign_keys.name: fk_event_expectation_event_ref_event
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: The descriptor belongs to the existing Event native owner rather than creating a second Event root.

foreign_keys.name: fk_event_expectation_self_person_ref_person
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: B03-A is intentionally self-scoped while Event remains distinct from later Participation/Actor semantics.

check_constraints.name: ck_event_expectation_title
check_constraints.reason: Reject empty, padded or unbounded minimum Event titles at the database boundary.

indexes.name: ix_event_expectation_self_person_created
indexes.reason: Deterministic self-scoped Event lookup/order without making presentation order canonical truth.

state_history.current_binding: This minimum expectation descriptor is selected directly by Event NativeRef; Schedule current/history remains a separate shared capability.
state_history.chronology: created_at records the authoritative Event creation instant; UUIDv7 ordering is never used as chronology.
state_history.immutability_policy: B03-A exposes create/read only. Later Event expectation editing must be governed explicitly rather than introduced as generic runtime UPDATE.

lifecycle.retention: Retained with the canonical Event even when the Event has no current Schedule, including postponed/TBD lifecycle states introduced later in B03.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime DELETE in B03-A. The introducing migration refuses downgrade once canonical Event expectation rows exist.

obligations: Event identity remains the existing UUIDv7 NativeRef and is not duplicated by the descriptor
runtime can read but cannot directly INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE the descriptor
title integrity and self-Person scope are enforced in real PostgreSQL
Event descriptor contains no Schedule, Recurrence, Participation, Session, Actual or Outcome collapse
